en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Ali, from Ibn Bukeyr, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not enter your houses in Makkah when you are Ziyarah (the Kabah)’ - meaning the inhabitants of Makkah’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from ibn Bukayr from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must not enter your lodgings when you visit the House, meaning thereby people of Makkah.’”
